data.dynamic.yml:
tls:
  certificates:
    - certFile: /etc/traefik/tls/tls.crt
      keyFile: /etc/traefik/tls/tls.key
http:
  middlewares:
    deny-all:
      ipAllowList:
        sourceRange:
          - "127.0.0.1/32"
  routers:
    deny-local-identity:
      rule: "PathRegexp(`^/m/mycel_iam/(users|roles|login)$`)"
      entryPoints: [web, websecure]
      priority: 10000
      middlewares: [deny-all]
      service: noop@internal
    deny-grafana-metrics:
      rule: "Host(`grafana.{{DOMAIN}}`) && PathPrefix(`/metrics`)"
      entryPoints: [web, websecure]
      priority: 10000
      middlewares: [deny-all]
      service: noop@internal
